import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:loho_ebook_reader/core/services/auth_service.dart';

class UserDataService {
  static final UserDataService instance = UserDataService._internal();
  factory UserDataService() => instance;

  late final Dio _dio;

  UserDataService._internal() {
    final baseOptions = BaseOptions(
      // Correct base URL from the API documentation
      baseUrl: 'https://elimupepe.loholearning.co.ke/api/student',
      connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 20),
      receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 20),
      headers: {'Accept': 'application/json'},
    );

    _dio = Dio(baseOptions);

    // Add an interceptor to automatically attach the auth token to every request
    _dio.interceptors.add(
      InterceptorsWrapper(
        onRequest: (options, handler) async {
          final token = await AuthService.instance.getToken();
          if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
            options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
          }
          return handler.next(options);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> fetchUserProfile() async {
    try {
      // Per documentation: POST to /profile
      final response = await _dio.post('/profile');
      if (response.statusCode == 200 && response.data['success'] == true) {
        return response.data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (kDebugMode) {
        print('Error fetching user profile: $e');
      }

  String? _buildIntendedPath(String? targetUrl) {
    if (targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    final parsed = Uri.tryParse(targetUrl.trim());
    if (parsed == null) {
      return null;
    }

    // If caller already passed a relative route (e.g. /file/1), keep it as-is.
    if (!parsed.hasScheme && targetUrl.trim().startsWith('/')) {
      return targetUrl.trim();
    }

    final host = parsed.host.toLowerCase();
    if (host != 'elimupepe.loholearning.co.ke') {
      return null;
    }

    final path = parsed.path.isEmpty ? '/' : parsed.path;
    if (parsed.query.isEmpty) {
      return path;
    }
    return '$path?${parsed.query}';
  }

  String? _extractGeneratedWebviewToken(dynamic payload) {
    if (payload is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
      return null;
    }

    final direct =
        payload['token'] ??
        payload['webview_token'] ??
        payload['login_token'] ??
        payload['access_token'];
    if (direct is String && direct.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return direct.trim();
    }

    final data = payload['data'];
    if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final nested =
          data['token'] ??
          data['webview_token'] ??
          data['login_token'] ??
          data['access_token'];
      if (nested is String && nested.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        return nested.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  ) async {
    final candidates = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
      '/student/books': {'course_id': courseId},
      '/student/elibrary': {'course_id': courseId},
      '/student/quizzes': {'course_id': courseId},
    };

    for (final entry in candidates.entries) {
      try {
        final response = await _dio.get(
          entry.key,
          queryParameters: entry.value,
          options: _authorizedOptions(),
        );

        final items = _extractItems(response.data);
        for (final item in items) {
          if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
            final url = _extractUrlFromMap(item);
            if (url != null) {
              debugPrint(

class ImageUrlResolver {
  static const String _defaultBaseUrl = 'https://elimupepe.loholearning.co.ke';

  static const List<String> _imageKeys = [
    'avatar',
    'avatar_url',
    'avatarUrl',
    'image',
    'image_url',
    'imageUrl',
    'photo',
    'photo_url',
    'photoUrl',
    'cover',
    'cover_url',
    'coverUrl',
    'thumbnail',
    'thumbnail_url',
    'thumbnailUrl',
    'icon',
    'icon_url',
    'iconUrl',
    'banner',
    'banner_url',
    'bannerUrl',
  ];

  static String? fromMap(
    Map<String, dynamic>? data, {
    String baseUrl = _defaultBaseUrl,
  }) {
    if (data == null) return null;

    for (final key in _imageKeys) {
      final normalized = normalize(data[key], baseUrl: baseUrl);
      if (normalized != null) return normalized;
    }

    final nestedCandidates = [data['media'], data['images'], data['image']];
    for (final candidate in nestedCandidates) {
      if (candidate is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final nested = fromMap(candidate, baseUrl: baseUrl);
        if (nested != null) return nested;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  static String? normalize(dynamic raw, {String baseUrl = _defaultBaseUrl}) {
    if (raw == null) return null;

    final value = raw.toString().trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return null;

    final uri = Uri.tryParse(value);
    if (uri != null && uri.hasScheme) {
      return value;
    }

    if (value.startsWith('//')) {
      return 'https:$value';
    }

    if (value.startsWith('/')) {
      return '$baseUrl$value';
    }

    if (value.startsWith('www.')) {
      return 'https://$value';
    }

    if (value.contains('/')) {
      return '$baseUrl/$value';
    }

    return null;
  }
}

   static String? normalize(dynamic raw, {String baseUrl = _defaultBaseUrl}) {
@@
     return null;
   }
+
+  static String? withCacheBuster(
+    String? url, {
+    String? cacheKey,
+    String queryKey = 'v',
+  }) {
+    if (url == null) return null;
+
+    final trimmed = url.trim();
+    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return null;
+
+    final key = cacheKey?.trim();
+    if (key == null || key.isEmpty) {
+      return trimmed;
+    }
+
+    final uri = Uri.tryParse(trimmed);
+    if (uri == null) {
+      return trimmed;
+    }
+
+    final updatedParams = Map<String, String>.from(uri.queryParameters);
+    updatedParams[queryKey] = key;
+
+    return uri.replace(queryParameters: updatedParams).toString();
+  }
 }

I added cache-busting support in [image_url_resolver.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/core/utils/image_url_resolver.dart), then updated the save/load flow in [update_profile_screen.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/features/profile/update_profile_screen.dart), [profile_screen.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/features/profile/profile_screen.dart), [profile_screen.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/features/auth/profile_screen.dart), [main_view.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/features/home/main_view.dart), and [dashboard_screen.dart](/home/joe/Videos/Code/new/loho-ebook-reader/lib/features/home/dashboard_screen.dart). When the user updates their avatar, the app now stores a fresh cache key and appends it to the image URL so `NetworkImage` fetches the new asset immediately.

I also fixed the async `mounted` check in the profile update flow. `dart analyze` passes for these changes with no errors; the only remaining analyzer output is existing `withOpacity` deprecation info in the profile/update screens. If you want, I can clean those up next too.
